Forty-nine (49) sites designated Land Use Category "C" were selected for noise measurement as being representative of the area land use. The measured L10 noise levels ranged from 65 dBA to 86 dBA with twelve (12) sites having exisitng L10 noise levels greater than the design year noise level standard of PPM 90-2 (75 dBA). Seven (7) sites were found to have existing measured L10 noise levels equal to the design year noise level standard of 75 dBA.
The predicted 1990 traffic generated L10 noise levels for the forty-nine (49) sites designated land Use Category "C" selected as being representative of the area land use ranged from 62.9 dBA to 83.6 dBA. Of the forty-nine (49) sites, forty-six (46) sites were computed to have predicted 1990 traffic generated L10 noise levels greater than the design year L10 noise level standard of PPM 90-2 (75 dBA).
Twenty-eight (28) land use sites designated Land Use Category "B" were selected for noise measurement as being representative of the area land use. The measured L10 noise levels ranged from less than 60 dBA to 77 dBA with nine (9) sites having existing L10 noise levels greater than the design year noise level standard contained in PPM 90-2 for Land Use Category "B" (70 dBA). Four (4) sites were found to have existing measured L10 noise levels equal to the design year L10 noise level standard of 70 dBA.
The predicted 1990 traffic generated L10 noise levels for the twenty-eight (28) sites designated Land Use Category "B" selected as being representative of the area land use ranged from 63.2 dBA to 83.9 dBA. Of the twenty-eight (28) sites, twenty-six (26) sites were computed to have predicted 1990 traffic generated exterior L10 noise levels greater than the design year exterior L10 noise level standard of PPM 90-2 (70 dBA).
The climate in the northern Illinois area, in which this project is located can be characterized by cold winter months and warm summer months. It can be reasonably assumed that many of the residential buildings in the area of this proposed improvement will be air-conditioned and have storm windows several months out of the year by 1990.
